_comment: Inferno MCP server config — pick ONE of the blocks below, copy it into your MCP client's config under 'mcpServers', and restart the client. Claude Desktop: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows), ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS). The Inferno gateway + workers must be running (scripts\run-all.bat, or `docker compose up`).
_option_1_docker: RECOMMENDED — no local Python environment needed. Requires `docker compose up` (or at least the gateway) to be running. host.docker.internal lets the container reach a gateway on your host; on Linux add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway.
_option_2_local_python: Use your own interpreter. Edit BOTH absolute paths to match your machine.
_option_3_sse: Already running the compose stack? The `mcp` service exposes SSE at http://localhost:8200/sse — point any SSE-capable MCP client there instead of spawning a process.
